import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return

    n = int(data[0])
    full = (1 << n) - 1
    answer = 0

    def dfs(row, cols, diag1, diag2):
        nonlocal answer
        if row == n:
            answer += 1
            return

        available = full & ~(cols | diag1 | diag2)
        while available:
            bit = available & -available
            available -= bit
            dfs(
                row + 1,
                cols | bit,
                ((diag1 | bit) << 1) & full,
                (diag2 | bit) >> 1
            )

    dfs(0, 0, 0, 0)
    sys.stdout.write(str(answer) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
